description: Publish a post NOW to every ready channel of it — a real, public post in the business's name that followers see at once and that cannot be taken back from Obriym. A channel already published is never sent twice, so calling it again only retries the channels that failed or were not ready. Returns, per channel, the outcome (published, failed, already_published, skipped_not_configured with the setup step, skipped_empty, skipped_unsupported), the link to the live post and the network's error. Needs the owner's "AI may publish to social channels" switch (publishingEnabled in list_content_channels). Confirm with the person before calling it unless they asked for the publication outright. Echoes the workspace.

id.description: The publication id returned by create_content_post or list_content_posts.

name: publish_content_post
title: Publish post now
